update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.3 - Result-screen recovery, the Follow Trainer stall, a scroll crash, and two new trainees
- New: presets for Biwa Hayahide and Mejiro Ryan (the roster is now 29 trainees across 87 presets). - Fixed: the bot now advances result and event screens -- goal-complete, race results, hint and achievement popups, and day-end event dialogue -- by pressing their Skip or Next button, instead of churning through several unknown-screen recovery cycles first. - Fixed: the "Follow Trainer" prompt that Auto-Fill can raise no longer stalls a queued run; it is dismissed by default. - Fixed: a short scrollable list (such as the post-purchase "choose how many to use" screen) could crash the random tap picker; the tap bounds are now ordered so it cannot. - Fixed: "Prioritize Skill Hints" now respects the failure-chance, energy, and blacklist limits like every other training, and applies in every year.
